content.text: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-poaching covenant appears anywhere in the agreement.

input.quote: This Agreement shall not be deemed to create a partnership or joint venture and neither Party is the other's agent, partner, employee or representative.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce", "recruit", "personnel" and "employ" return no personnel covenant; the only "shall not" restrictions are the exclusivity provisions (p0037, p0042), confidentiality (p0048, p0053, p0054) and the no-joint-venture clause (p0061), and the only references to employees are incidental (indemnity and relationship-of-parties language). Section 5.4's appointed-representative provisions likewise impose no hiring restraint. Since no non-solicitation or no-hire obligation binds the Company (our client), the agreement already meets our preferred position of no non-solicit on the Customer, and no redline is needed.
